fixes.issue: ESN development scaler used standard deviation across date-level cross-sectional means, discarding within-date stock-day dispersion.
fixes.fix: Equal date-weighted stock-day mean; two-pass variance equals mean over dates of each date cross-sectional mean squared deviation from global weighted mean.
fixes.test: Synthetic unequal stock counts verify mean 52.5 and variance 2268.75.

fixes.issue: Factor-rescaling probe concatenated securities and computed pct_change/rolling across ticker boundaries; absolute-only 1e-12 check failed on float64 residue.
fixes.fix: Production sequence_inputs run per complete global calendar for original and per-security rescaled factors; exact validity/nonfinite-mask checks, reject infinities, compare finite fields with rtol=1e-10/atol=1e-12 and report max absolute/relative discrepancies. Runs before any fit.
fixes.test: Synthetic two-security source with a missing bar passes production-path rescaling and missing-mask checks.

fixes.issue: State columns were indexed as q[k], and support ESS summed q by stock rows, overweighting days with more stocks.
fixes.fix: Use q0/q1 columns; aggregate q to one mean per distinct training date, then mass=sum(q_day), ESS=sum(q_day)^2/sum(q_day^2); training dates with missing state use q=.5; missing prediction state uses whole-day E00-rank fallback. Expert-month fallback fraction denominator is explicitly the 2 January expert-month opportunities.
fixes.test: Unequal stock-row counts leave two-date mass/ESS equal to date-level contract.

fixes.issue: SQ01 cold rows had ready-only model ranks, then another rerank, violating full-pool rank calibration.
fixes.fix: Rank readout predictions over each complete E00 prediction pool including cold rows; center percentile by -0.5; then replace cold rows by same-date centered E00 percentile rank without reranking.

fixes.issue: Sequence input path relied on source row order and could compress a globally missing date.
fixes.fix: Reindex every security to the complete state/global calendar; missing bars remain explicit NaN rows and reset hidden state/warmup; recurrent computation remains causal.
fixes.test: Synthetic omitted stock-session retained as invalid global-calendar row; perturbing future inputs leaves all prior hidden states unchanged.

fixes.issue: Prediction dataframes/readers included future label/outcome columns.
fixes.fix: Separate projections: prediction panel contains features/states/readiness only; baseline only keys+score; labels loaded separately for exact mature training keys. Jan prediction output contains keys plus model outputs only.
fixes.test: Projection contract asserts future-label fields excluded.

fixes.issue: HMM/ESN results were not checkpointed before downstream checks; reruns could overwrite/duplicate work.
fixes.fix: Fresh v2 output; immutable code/input/contract/recovery-auth freeze; signed source SHAs rechecked; all deterministic preflight checks before fit; HMM start marker and atomic parameters/diagnostics checkpoint saved/read-back before filtering; ESN Parquet+manifest atomic; stale/mismatched or orphaned checkpoints refuse refit; prior v1 HMM attempt explicitly carried. V2 runner refuses to fit without a new recovery authorization bound to runner SHA, prior attempt count, exact Jan2024 fit list and cumulative cap>=5; other months/accounts/2026 remain false.
fixes.test: Matching checkpoint is reused without calling hmm_em; orphaned marker blocks an uncounted refit.

fixes.issue: Causal forward filter needed a direct pure numerical prefix/normalization test.
fixes.fix: Explicit normalized log-space forward recursion; missing emissions propagate using the transition matrix; no smoothing output.
fixes.test: Fixed-parameter prefix equals full filter prefix exactly, probabilities finite and sum to one.

fixes.issue: Ridge weights had mean one and total N while adding lambda*I, so actual regularization strength depended on training-row count and violated the signed objective.
fixes.fix: Only Ridge readout now uses equal-date weights normalized to sum 1; LightGBM keeps its original mean-one weights. Diagnostics record pre/post weight sums, weighted SSE, lambda penalty and full objective.
fixes.test: Hand-calculated weighted SSE + unpenalized-intercept Ridge penalty matches diagnostics; duplicating an entire same-date cross-section preserves each date total mass, coefficients and objective.

remaining_limitations: The v1 HMM parameters were not checkpointed and cannot be resumed; a same-parameter HMM recovery is a second project-level attempt and requires a new signed coordinator authorization.
Real frozen-input preflight, first-month model fits and timing were not rerun in this code-review stage.
No Jan2024 RG/SQ predictions exist; the post-selection rank-drop/path diagnostic remains unrun.
